description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It manages the activity lifecycle, sets up navigation components including a drawer layout, bottom navigation, and supports navigation actions such as opening and closing the drawer, and handling navigation UI features.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity managing navigation drawer and bottom navigation components, providing a structured way for users to navigate through different sections of the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up toolbar, navigation controllers, drawer toggle, and listeners for navigation events.

methods.name: onSupportNavigateUp
methods.description: Handles the 'Up' navigation action, delegating to NavigationUI's navigateUp method.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Overrides default back button behavior to close the navigation drawer if it is open.
